defects.file: PR body "## Evidence" make lint block
defects.claim: `make lint` exits with an error (`make: *** [Makefile:101: lint] Error 1`) on 3 staticcheck SA4023 findings. All are in `cmd/pilot/tunnel.go` (lines 205, 351, 433), which this diff does not touch, so the failure predates the PR and is unrelated to it.

the dirty check counts untracked files as uncommitted changes. `HasUncommittedChanges` runs `git status --porcelain` (git.go:1398) and returns true on any output (git.go:1404). So a stray untracked, non-ignored file left in the clone produces the same refusal on every re-pick, and the identical-failure streak (threshold 2) still parks the task. The error now names the real cause, which is what the scope asks for, but the task still gets parked.
defects.evidence: nil`, git.go:1404). `checkGitClean` skips excluded paths (`if isExcluded(path) { continue }`, preflight.go:221), such as `.agent/`, `.claude/` and `*.lock`. So a clone on the stale branch whose only dirt is, for example, a modified `.claude/settings.json` passes the preflight at runner.go:4093. It then gets the same "checked out in the clone, refusing" error on every re-pick, and the identical-failure rule parks it again. The issue asked for HasUncommittedChanges, so this is a gap in the spec rather than a missed requirement.
